part_number.note: 24-character MOT string as stored in the RDB (PARTNO=0651RA01XAA8AE2A311XXXXX, with the leading catalog 0). Positions 8, 13, 16 are fixed digits (constant '1','A','A' across all observed part numbers and the doc header template). Drawing layers only cover Extra Inputs/Outputs (GROUP_1) and Communications Interface (GROUP_2); their layer source.position values (8 and 10) are OFFSET from this stored-PN index by +4 (real positions 12 and 14) because the drawing indexes a truncated part-number origin - positions here are calibrated to the real stored part numbers, which are authoritative. Extra I/O option codes 8/B/C are not enumerated in WI-12760 (which lists only X and A) but are taken from the sibling SEL-651R-2 WI-9861 MOT; code 8 is used by real 651RA part numbers.
references: SEL-651R-2 Ordering Information (WI-9861) - fuller Extra Inputs/Outputs option list (codes 8, B, C)
SEL-651RA master configuration drawing i7167a (drawing layers GROUP_1, GROUP_2)
